title: Wrist ganglion removal
what: A ganglion is a soft lump filled with fluid near a joint or tendon in the hand. The surgeon removes it through a small cut.
why: When the lump gets in the way, hurts, grows or presses on a nerve.
duration: surgery usually takes 20 to 60 minutes, and you usually go home the same day
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners - your doctor will tell you what to stop and when
If the lump has been drained or removed before

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Sometimes an ultrasound of the hand and blood tests are done. The clinic will give you the list.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: If you will have general anesthesia, you usually do not eat from the evening before. For local numbing, ask the clinic.

prepare.title: Rings
prepare.text: Take off rings and bracelets from that hand in advance.

steps: Your hand is cleaned with an antiseptic
You get numbing by an injection in the arm, or general anesthesia
The surgeon makes a small cut over the lump
The ganglion is removed together with its lining
The wound is stitched and bandaged, sometimes with a splint
feel: The numbing injections are unpleasant, but during the surgery you feel pressure without pain
Afterwards there is aching pain and swelling, and you are given a painkiller
after: Keep your hand raised for the first days
Stitches are usually removed after 1 to 2 weeks
Increase the load on your hand gradually, as the surgeon tells you
red_flags: Severe pain, swelling, redness or pus from the wound
Fingers that are numb, pale or blue - see a doctor right away

faq.a: Sometimes yes, even after surgery. The surgeon will explain how to lower this risk.
